# Event sheet 2
# Source: eventSheets/UI/Event sheet 2.json

group "Second Layout Events" (active)
  static isActive: boolean = true

  block
    when: NavButton.on-clicked()
    when: System.compare-boolean-eventvar(variable=isActive)
    when: System.compare-eventvar(variable=score, comparison=5 (≥), value=10)
    do: System.go-to-layout-by-name(layout="Main Layout")
    do: Text[Timer].stop-timer(tag="test")

  block
    when: System.on-start-of-layout()

    block
      do: System.add-to-eventvar(variable=inner1, value=1)
      do: TextInput.set-text(text=str(inner1))

    var inner1: number = 2

    block
      do: System.add-to-eventvar(variable=inner1, value=1)
      do: Text.set-text(text=str(inner1))
